svg.title: How to read the result: five scoring lanes and the four honest outcomes each verdict allows
svg.desc: A how-to-read-the-result explainer for the normal-only gait world model. The left card lists the five scoring lanes: A the trained normal-only world model that we test, B the untrained random-encoder floor it must beat, C the visibility-only nuisance that must not copy the channel pattern, D the pooled single-scalar control, and E the non-neural raw-coordinate ceiling it must reach at least 80 percent of. The right column is a ladder of four possible outcomes. F1 clean positive: it beats the floor, is selective, and reaches at least 80 percent of the ceiling, so the mechanism-decomposition claim is earned. F2 localizing null: it beats the floor and is selective but falls below 80 percent of the ceiling, so it only localizes the corrupted joint. F3 diffuse null: it fails to beat the floor or shows no selectivity, so the surprise is unstructured. F4 artifact: the visibility-only lane reproduces the pattern, so the effect is a missingness artifact and the claim is withdrawn. All illustrative and transductive to the single normal source video; folder labels are dataset annotations, not diagnoses.
